title: The Spirit Bear
text: A white bear stands in the path, huge and silent, its fur glowing faintly in the gloom. It is a spirit of the trees, and it blocks the way. It does not growl. It waits for a gift, and watches what you do.

options.label: Give it honey and bread, and ask its leave to pass.

outcomes.text: It steps aside, and the wood is kinder after.

options.label: The devout bows to it, as one bows to the old powers.

outcomes.text: It touches their brow with a nose cold as snow, and luck goes with them.

options.label: The Leader pushes past it. You will not be stopped by a bear.
